title: Amazing tour
text: Initially Sharif was supposed to take us on the tour but an emergency came up and his colleague Ahmed came instead. He was amazing from start to finish. We learned so much on the tour and he was so patient with us especially having a toddler with us. We were able to tour alhamra and our breaths were taken away at the beautiful sight. I want to thank them for this amazing experience and let’s not forget sharif made reservations for a van to pick us up from Granada to Malaga. They are a one stop shop and can be trusted. Thank you Sharif and Ahmed for this wonderful experience:)

title: VIEW TO THE ALAMBRA WITH THE BEST GUIDE
text:
Sheriff is an exceptional Guide. 
The visit to the Alhambra would have been totally different had it not been for its impeccable quality as Guide and extensive detailed knowledge. 
I know his experience as a Tour Guide and as a Tour Leader, and also being a Great Pro, he is a better person and a fatigue partner as I have had few. 

We must return to Granada soon. 
If you haven't seen Granada, you haven't seen anything. 

Gracias Sheriff
See you soon.
author: Albbilbo

title: Time travel
text: It was amazing, better than I expected. Reality surpasses any photo or video you can see previously. Also with the hand of Guide Sherif, the experience was like time travel. It tells you the whole story and intertwined with stories that lead you to feel the wonder of that time. You understand everything, read the inscriptions and translate them... Stunning culture mixed with entertainment. Recommended 1,000%
